content.instructions: Say a year in hundreds up to 1999 (“neunzehnhundertneunundachtzig”) and as a number from 2000 (“zweitausendvierundzwanzig”). Say “im Jahr 1989” or just “1989”. For a date use “am” and the ordinal: “am neunten November”.
